messages:
Maria C: Hey all — quick sync on streaming + quota correctness. We saw a customer report where reconnecting a stream after a flaky connection resulted in ~2x token billing. Is that expected with current per-key leaky-bucket enforcement?
Aj Patel: Short answer: yes, in some edge cases. We count tokens as they are emitted. If client reconnects and replayed suffix tokens are emitted again, they get counted again.
Samir B: Today the stream has no consumer-visible resume id. Clients just reconnect and the model starts at the nearest checkpoint. We tried to avoid server-side state for each connection to keep scale.
Camille R: From console/UX pov customers are confused — they see "spike" in token usage when mobile clients hit flaky cellular. We should show "in-flight streams" and a note for resumed streams in the billing timeline.
Oliver H: Billing-wise double-counting is nasty. If we keep current behaviour, we should at least mark resumed ranges in telemetry and produce a reconciliation job for monthly invoices.
Aj Patel: Proposal: add an optional resume-token header and a small idempotency window on the server (30s per key) that dedupes overlapping token ranges. Minimal state: store last-ack (resume-token -> last_seq) in memstore with TTL.
Samir B: Implementation sketch:
```
Client sends: X-Resume-Token: sha256(client_conn_id + stream_seed)
Server stores: resumes:{org_key}:{resume_token} -> last_serialized_offset (ttl=30s)
On reconnect: client sends resume_token + start_offset; server compares and skips already-billed tokens.
```
This keeps storage tiny and per-key.
Maria C: What about partial tokens? e.g., token broken across packets, or reconnect mid-token. We can't really "skip" mid-token reliably.
Aj Patel: We bill on token boundaries as emitted by tokenizer so server-level serializer is authoritative. If reconnect splits a token, server will coalesce and either re-emit or suppress depending on offset comparison. Edge: if we can't guarantee, fallback is to refund later.
qa-bot: Reproducer posted: https://ci.internal/repro/stream-reconnect-142 — flakey device + reconnect under 5s -> double count 1-3 tokens usually. Test added to streaming-tests.
Camille R: Console change: show "resumed" badge on streams with a link to the resume-token so SREs can inspect. Also add per-org burst window UI (slider) with tooltip: "approx. seconds of burst preserved".
Oliver H: Pricing/legal: we should avoid automatic refunds; instead emit "suspicious double-count" flag and auto-credit for volumes < 100 tokens but escalate bigger ones.
Samir B: Edge-case: Many tiny clients could abuse resume window to replay and hide traffic. Need anti-abuse: limit resume window to 30s and only allow for the same org_key + same client-supplied origin IP fingerprint or signature.
Maria C: Action items:
- @Aj implement memstore resume TTL + dedupe logic (PR target EOW)
- @Samir add protocol header + fallback behavior to runtime
- @Camille add console badge + "resumed" telemetry in dashboard
- @Oliver and finance draft small refund policy for <100 tokens auto-credit
- @qa-bot expand test matrix for reconnects, mid-token split, and load tests

Aj Patel: I'll spin up a spike: small in-memory map + per-key sharding. If perf looks good we'll persist to redis with LRU TTL.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: streaming-resume-spike -> staging at 2026-03-20T04:00Z :rocket:
Maria C: Perfect. Keep replies inline here with blockers. Thanks :+1:
